text: Practice how to put the main technical reasoning stages in order.
Begin with the user problem and finish by checking intended use.

items: Name the stakeholder need: Example: The purpose comes before a detailed technical answer.
Write measurable requirements: Requirements turn the need into checkable demands.
Implement the chosen design: Implementation uses the requirements and design decisions.
Verify against requirements: Verification checks the implemented result against its conditions.
Validate intended use: Validation checks whether the outcome serves stakeholders.
